llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found the same core behavior: local setup files and a disclosed debate loop.
[VirusTotal telemetry] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and described only local file operations; this supports but does not alone determine the verdict.
[Executable setup.sh] expected: The installer creates prompt files, state.json, output directories, and a heartbeat snippet, which matches the skill purpose.
[Heartbeat loop instructions] expected: The loop can produce repeated agent work and local report files, but this is disclosed and has a configured iteration limit.
llm.guidance: Install into a directory you control, and avoid pointing setup.sh at an existing folder with files you care about because it writes fixed filenames. Review the generated prompts before adding the heartbeat snippet, and avoid placing secrets in the workflow unless you are comfortable with them appearing in local reports.
llm.summary: This skill sets up a local self-review workflow for an AI agent and does not show hidden network access, credential use, or destructive behavior.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: xeonen-arena
Version: 1.0.0

The skill implements an adversarial self-improvement framework ('Arena System') designed to reduce AI hallucinations through a structured debate loop. Analysis of setup.sh and SKILL.md shows the code only performs local file operations (creating directories and markdown templates) and maintains state in a JSON file, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.
